In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack offers a different set of options, one that prioritizes ownership and control. How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are notorious for their restrictive policies, blocking accounts and imposing severe limitations on online commerce in certain countries. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to operate independently of these restrictions, using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments to facilitate payments across borders.
